## v0.5.16 · Chinese Metadata, Native Sidebar and Source Scrolling

- [#286](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/286) adds Chinese root-plugin metadata with English manifest fallback, checks packed locale resources and includes locale-only changes in release validation. The contributor's original commit [`d16d017`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/commit/d16d017aa5bb0c3bbbdb40dc5a95554266b6522a) is preserved.
- [#287](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/287) uses DSH's native Sidebar and main panel, fixes switching between Plugins and Memory System, and retains Source state on return. Native styling, collapsed navigation and the tested Maid Atelier skin keep the page header accessible.
- [#288](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/288) aligns Source frames and scrolling with Status, retains the Memory Spaces title/tab header, and reveals Related headings and close buttons below it without scrolling other panels.

### Packages and upgrade

**dsh-mnemon 0.5.16** and **dsh-mnemon-source-memory-spaces 0.5.10** form the updated composition; the other fifteen companion packages retain their versions. Upgrade both for the complete fix. The Starter pins all seventeen packages.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.16
```

Back up the Profile and relevant data, then restart DSH and reload the browser after upgrading. Use `headless` for that Profile. The Client floor remains DSH 0.1.5-rc.1; complete profiles require Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

No persistence migration is required. The Source scroll callbacks are optional; older Hosts remain compatible but require manual scrolling. Mnemon CLI is independently maintained.

Published DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 still shows `cordis:group` as Off while its children run; clicking the container's switch can return `unknown-plugin`. This release does not patch DSH or install a replacement plugin-management adapter.

### 中文说明

本版为 DSH 中的主插件增加中文元数据，保留英文回退和贡献者原始提交，并补齐 locale 制品与发布校验；将记忆系统接入原生 Sidebar 和主面板，修复面板切换、皮肤下标题可见性与返回时的 Source 状态保留；让 Source 页面框架和滚动对齐状态页，并确保关联记忆标题与关闭按钮显示在固定头部下方。

Root 升级至 **0.5.16**，Memory Spaces Source 升级至 **0.5.10**，其余十五个插件版本不变。完整修复需两者一起升级，Starter 已固定全部十七个包。升级前备份 Profile 与相关数据，升级后重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。无需持久化迁移；新增滚动回调可选，旧 Host 可继续工作但需手动滚动。

官方 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 的 `cordis:group` 显示 Off、开关返回 `unknown-plugin` 问题仍存在。本版不包含运行时 DSH 补丁或替代插件管理服务的适配器。

- [Chinese metadata / 中文元数据](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.16/docs/pr-assets/pr-286-plugin-metadata/README.md)
- [Native Sidebar and skins / 原生 Sidebar 与皮肤](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.16/docs/pr-assets/sidebar-native-20260926/README.md)

The versioned seventeen-artifact composition passed real Flash WebUI and official CLI acceptance, including Runtime and Documents archival, Native recall, Sidebar/page-frame behavior and cold-restart persistence. Thirteen real Flash requests returned HTTP 200. Root verification passed 1,421 tests; all sixteen independent plugin repositories, the external consumer and v0.4.7 upgrade passed. [Release evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.16/docs/pr-assets/release-v0.5.16/README.md) records screenshots, artifact identities, local concurrency reruns and scope limits.

版本化的全部十七个制品已通过真实 Flash WebUI 与官方 CLI 验收，包含 Runtime 和 Documents 归档、Native 召回、Sidebar/页面框架及冷重启数据保留。十三次真实 Flash 请求全部返回 HTTP 200；Root 测试 1,421 项通过，十六个独立插件仓库、外部消费者和 v0.4.7 升级均通过。[中文验收记录](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.16/docs/pr-assets/release-v0.5.16/README.zh-CN.md)包含截图、制品标识、本机并发重跑情况与验证范围。
